title: Recriminate
summary: RECRIM'INATE, verb intransitive [Latin re and criminor, to accuse.] 1. To return one accusation with another. It is not my business to recriminate 2. To charge an accuser with the like crime. RECRIM'I

inlines.v: RECRIM'INATE, verb intransitive [Latin re and criminor, to accuse.] 1. To return one accusation with another. It is not my business to recriminate 2. To charge an accuser with the like crime. RECRIM'INATE, verb transitive To accuse in return.
